description: This Java class 'DefaultSseConfig' provides the default implementation of the Server-Sent Events (SSE) configuration, specifically managing throttling settings through a ThrottlingConfig object and constructing instances from external configuration inputs.

classes.name: DefaultSseConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the SseConfig interface managing throttling configuration settings based on provided configuration data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DefaultSseConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getThrottlingConfig
methods.description: Returns the throttling configuration object associated with this SSE configuration.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare DefaultSseConfig instances based on throttlingConfig.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode consistent with equals, based on throttlingConfig.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the DefaultSseConfig instance, including throttlingConfig.
